title: Let your agent draw. We make sure the diagram works.
snippet:
Mermaid diagrams for your code, agents and products. One API call.

## One request. A real answer.
bash
```
curl https://api.mermaid.ai/v1/render \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $MERMAID_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"code": "flowchart TD\n  A[Start] --> B[Done]", "format": "svg"}' \
-o diagram.svg
```
The response is the image itself, ready to write to disk.

Mermaid API is a hosted service that runs Mermaid for you: your program sends diagram code over HTTP and gets back a validation result, an image, or new diagram code.
No. Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans include a bigger allowance.
Costs depend on the operation and options; stored-diagram reads are free. Your monthly allowance is spent first, then any credits you have bought. See the current costs in [api.mermaid.ai/v1/docs](https://api.mermaid.ai/v1/docs); the free balance endpoint also returns your balance and endpoint costs. For high volume, contact sales.

title: MCP Server — Mermaid Chart
snippet:
The Mermaid MCP Server supports multiple transport modes, and **every tool call requires authentication** with a Mermaid account. Authentication is free — you can sign up for a free Mermaid account (the Basic tier) to get started. Authenticate automatically via **OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration** (for clients that support OAuth discovery, such as VS Code, Cursor, and Antigravity via `mcp-remote`), or manually by pasting a Mermaid token into your client configuration. See Authentication Setup below for details on both options.

Every tool call requires you to be logged in to your Mermaid account. Signing up is free — the Basic tier costs nothing.

title: What plans are available?
snippet:
Mermaid offers four plans:
- Basic — Free. 3 diagrams for individuals, 6 for team accounts, 15 AI credits.
- Plus — $10 per user per month (billed annually). Unlimited diagrams, 300 AI credits per year.
- Premium — $20 per user per month (billed annually). Unlimited diagrams, 2,000 AI credits, unlimited free viewer seats.
- Enterprise — Custom pricing. All Premium features plus SSO, a dedicated Customer Success Manager, custom contracts, and IP management.
All paid plans are billed **annually.** See the Pricing [page](https://mermaid.ai/web/pricing/) for full details.

title: Mermaid officially launched with sharable diagram links and presentation mode
snippet:
Mermaid offers a [range of pricing tiers](https://mermaid.ai/pricing) to fit your needs. The Basic plan is free and includes up to three diagrams with limited AI and one team & project creation. The Plus plan costs $10 per user/month (billed annually) and includes unlimited diagrams, limitless diagram size, 300 AI credits per year, and view & comment collaboration.

For advanced users and teams, the Premium plan ($20 per user/month, billed annually) adds 2,000 AI credits per year, unlimited free viewer seats, co-editing collaboration and external sharing, and robust security with SSO. Enterprise pricing is also available for organizations that need scale and control, with custom contracts, admin access to team diagrams, and a dedicated Customer Success Manager.
